title: French Toast with Blueberry Compote
excerpt: Enjoy a special breakfast with this golden French toast and a warm compote of high-mountain blueberries.
imageAlt: Golden French toast served on a white plate with a generous warm compote of fresh blueberries.

ingredients.text: 4 slices brioche or thick sliced bread

steps: In a deep bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, vanilla and half of the cinnamon until well combined.

For the compote, place the Fresh Pick blueberries in a small skillet over medium heat with the sugar and two tablespoons of water. Cook for 5 minutes until the fruit releases its juices and a thick sauce forms. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, making sure it gets well soaked on both sides without falling apart.
Heat a wide skillet with the butter over medium heat. Place the bread slices and brown for 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden.
Serve the French toast hot, right out of the skillet, and top it generously with the warm compote of blueberries grown in Guasca.
tips: To better preserve your blueberries at home, store them in the fridge unwashed and remove any that look overripe before storing them.
If you prefer a more aromatic touch, you can add a pinch of lemon zest to the compote while it cooks in the skillet.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
